worksheet.deviation_description: No flow of natural gas feed to Primary Reformer
consequences: Loss of feed to Primary Reformer (R-001) leading to process upset
Overheating of reformer tubes if heat input from fuel burners is not reduced
safeguard_gaps: Low natural gas flow safety interlock to trip fuel gas
recommendations: Install a low-flow alarm and an automated safety interlock to trip burner fuel on low natural gas flow

worksheet.deviation_description: No steam flow to Primary Reformer
causes: FCV-101 steam side valve fails closed
consequences: Rapid catalyst coking (carbon deposition) on R-001 reformer tubes
Overheating and potential rupture of reformer tubes due to localized hot spots

existing_safeguards.description: Flow measurement and ratio controller RS-104 matching steam and gas flows

recommendations: Install a high-integrity low steam flow trip system to cut off feed gas and burner fuel in the event of steam failure

worksheet.deviation_description: Excessive fuel gas flow to R-001 burners
causes: Fuel control valve FCV-103 fails fully open
Upstream fuel gas header pressure surge
consequences: Excessive heat duty in R-001 firebox
Overheating of reformer tubes leading to mechanical deformation, accelerated creep, or tube rupture

existing_safeguards.description: Flow transmitter and control loop on fuel line

recommendations: Implement a high-pressure/high-flow fuel gas trip interlock to isolate fuel gas on high-high flow
Ensure tube skin temperature monitoring is active with high-temperature alarms in the DCS

worksheet.deviation_description: Less combustion air flow to burners
consequences: Incomplete combustion in the furnace, resulting in carbon monoxide generation
Potential accumulation of unburnt fuel in the firebox, creating an explosion risk upon ignition/re-ignition
recommendations: Install a low air flow alarm and integrate a burner management system (BMS) with flame scanners to safely trip fuel on loss of combustion air

worksheet.deviation_description: High process temperature in Primary Reformer
causes: Low process gas flow (mismatch with heat input)
consequences: Thermal stress and cracking of reformer catalyst tubes
Catastrophic tube rupture leading to process gas fire in the furnace box

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature controller and monitoring loop on reformer outlet

recommendations: Install an independent safety-instrumented high temperature trip on the reformer outlet line to isolate fuel

causes: Downstream blockage in secondary reformer R-002 or waste heat boilers
consequences: Overstressing of reformer tubes and piping manifolds, leading to physical damage or rupture

existing_safeguards.description: Pressure safety relief valve on the outlet header

recommendations: Verify that the PSV is sized for blocked-outlet scenarios and perform regular testing of the relief valve

worksheet.deviation_description: High discharge pressure at Air Compressor K-001
causes: Blockage in downstream air line to secondary reformer R-002
Closed isolation valves on downstream lines
consequences: Compressor surge leading to severe vibration and potential damage to internal compressor components (blades, bearings, shaft seals)
recommendations: Install an automatic anti-surge recycle valve and configure a high-pressure trip in the DCS to protect the compressor from damage

worksheet.deviation_description: Complete loss of process air flow to R-002
causes: Trip/failure of Air Compressor K-001 turbine driver
Failure of steam control valve FCV-102 closed
consequences: Loss of secondary reforming reaction in R-002
Downstream process gas composition upset (lack of nitrogen for ammonia synthesis)
Potential backflow of flammable process gas from R-002 into the air piping if pressure is lost

existing_safeguards.description: Air flow transmitter and ratio monitoring

recommendations: Ensure a highly reliable non-return valve (check valve) is installed on the air line to prevent reverse flow of hot syngas
Implement a low air flow safety trip to isolate the air line and shut down the secondary reformer air feed safely

worksheet.deviation_description: Overheating of Secondary Reformer R-002 vessel
causes: Excessive air flow relative to primary reformer syngas feed
Loss of jacket cooling water level
consequences: Thermal damage to internal refractory lining
Deformation, swelling, or rupture of the high-pressure reformer vessel shell

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature transmitters monitoring interior and shell temperatures
Cooling water jacket level control system

recommendations: Configure an independent safety-instrumented high temperature interlock to trip process air to R-002 on high-high reactor shell or exit temperatures

worksheet.deviation_description: Low cooling water level in the jacket of Secondary Reformer R-002
consequences: Rapid loss of cooling to the reformer shell leading to overheating, structural steel weakening, and potential shell burst under operating pressure
recommendations: Install a low-low cooling jacket level trip that initiates safety isolation and depressurization of R-002 to protect the pressure vessel shell
